summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of Collector Parfum e-commerce app. Backend 100% healthy (147/147 tests passed). Frontend testing covered full shopping flow, cart persistence, import wizard 4D, and React warnings check. Main shopping flow (USER STORY 1 - MOST IMPORTANT) is WORKING - successfully completed order from product page to order success with code CP00000017. Import wizard 4D feature (USER STORY 6) is WORKING - successfully uploaded sample_4d.csv and verified all new UI components (dimension chip, structure panel, 4-dimension table). Cart persistence after refresh is WORKING. One React accessibility warning persists in Dialog components.
